@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: I'll go ahead and say this since this has been a bug for a much longer time. It isn't anything major or detracts from the experience, but it's on topic to this. An animated object on your avatar that is summoned through an override will not animate in the mirror if it's culled in your normal view. Basically, if it's not viewable in any other way, it will just stop on the last frame it was seen in. Again, it's not anything major, this issue is only seen clientside, but it's on the same subject.

comments.mergedPostDetails: To me, I've always loved VRChat for the ability to create my own particle effects and see them visually casting off the center/origin of the effect, the avatar. I'm not sure there remains a way to do this, which for me has taken away something really substantial from the game. If there could just be a way to locally toggle in our own settings, the ability to see just our own particles in the mirror and on camera, that would be stellar.
comments.mergedPostTitle: Be somehow able to see your own particle effects in the mirror/camera again

comments.mergedPostDetails: After the Unity version upgrade, mesh renderer updates will not appear in cameras and mirrors. Such things like Material updates, or mesh renderer toggles, will not update in mirrors/cameras

comments.mergedPostDetails:
Any object that is made to appear using IsActive instead of activating its Skinned/Mesh Renderer component will not show up in mirrors and the photo camera/stream camera. 

In addition, objects with the same name in the hierarchy, despite being located in different parts of the hierarchy, will randomly have the same position and material as the other object.

Apologies, but I'm curious if this has been addressed yet?
It's been a few months and I haven't been able to check myself but I was wondering if this issue was looked at / resolved?

Will there be a fix anytime?
It is a problem for a long time. I and many others would love to see a fix for that.

For me it's very inconsistent what is shown in the mirror and what not when it comes to particles. But it is super annoying. I'd like to have some nice thumbnails and screenshots but this is close to impossible. Mirrors do not reflect almost everything, The ingame camera doesn't as well and world cameras only in rare cases.

I have a bunch of particle systems in GameObjects with a fixed joint.

One is always active and follows my feet. It doesn't show trails but it does show the particle itself (mesh sphere with shader).

One is on my back, toggled with the inventory system. It is fully shown in mirrors with particle and trail when I toggle it. But it stays when I untoggle it.

The rest which follows hands and armature triggered with gesture combinations doesn't show up at all in mirrors.

A fix for these issues is currently live on the 2019.4.1 Open Beta. Please check your content and let us know if  things are working now. Also note that the Open Beta is on Unity 2018, so please reupload testing content to ensure correct behavior.
